# DeepL-oFM 1.0.6
Automatic updates with Sparkle 2, a manual **Check for Updates…** button, and a drag-and-drop signed DMG.
- Sparkle 2 with a signed appcast and EdDSA update signatures; daily checks. - Optional automatic download and installation. - The About window shows whether the app is up to date. - DMG contains an **Applications** shortcut; drag the app to install. - Signed and notarized DMG and app bundle.
The base model is still Hy-MT2 7B via Ollama; use 30B-A3B or a cloud model for publication-quality long texts.
